args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of an 8×30 m continuous precast T-girder unit (simply supported during erection, made continuous in service), 12.5 m deck, 5 girders per span.

Key modeling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system "continuous" (MR-05) — support lines named Pier 1–7 have no pier-column geometry, so they are modeled as bearings on rigid supports.
- Girder section (T-girder, C50): single-girder A=0.862 m², I=0.445 m⁴; 5 girders combined → A=4.31 m², I=2.225 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362 3.1.5); γ=26 kN/m³ (JTG D60 4.2.1, prestressed concrete upper bound); w=112.06 kN/m, m=11.423 t/m (MR-07, girder self-weight only).
- Bearings: 9 support lines, each with 5 bearings (1 per girder end). Abutments 0,8 and Piers 1,2,3,6,7 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (longitudinal free, Kh=0); Piers 4,5 = plain laminated elastomeric fixed (longitudinal spring, Kh=15000 kN/m). All laminated: 300×400 mm, 5×8 mm layers, Ge=1.0 MPa (JTG 3362 8.7), S=10.714, Kv=7.098×10⁶ kN/m per line; rotation free (MR-03, MR-04).
- Live load: JTG D60-2015 Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes (11.5 m carriageway) → ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320 kN per 30 m span. Modal f1=4.52 Hz → impact factor μ=0.2508 (JTG D60 4.3.2).

Results: first three vertical frequencies 4.52/4.70/5.23 Hz; max self-weight reaction 3807 kN at interior piers 1 and 7; lane-load max positive moment 8356 kN·m, max negative 6145 kN·m. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
